purpose: Translate the transferable auxiliary post-cue value interface into literal L11/L15 c_v reader rows, base attention routing, and selected c_proj writer blocks, while measuring any inherited initial-value branch separately.
compiled_equation: For layer l in {11,15}, DeltaV_l=(1-lambda_l)[c_v,l(x'_l)-c_v,l(x_l)]+lambda_l(v'initial,l-vinitial,l); R_l(q)=sum_{s in postcue} P_l,base(q,s) DeltaV_l(s); Write_l=c_proj,l(R_l) on selected head blocks. Install Write-equivalent head responses in causal order.

predictions.pred_a_authority_local_weight_closure_fi: Authorities pass; c_v mixture, selected post-cue response, c_proj block, attention reconstruction, and native base identity controls each close <=.001; metrics finite; <=8 forwards/240 examples and zero fits, backwards, or updates.
predictions.pred_b_compiled_response_matches_exact_c: Compiled versus captured post-cue intervention has behavior and Q8 cosine >=.999 and relative RMSE <=.01 in both panels.
predictions.pred_c_compiled_full_vocabulary_interven: Compiled versus exact full-vocabulary logits differ by <=1e-4 and final-state relative error is <=1e-4.
predictions.pred_d_initial_value_branch_is_character: The direct c_v and inherited initial-value response RMS fractions are both finite and their tensor sum closes to the complete compiled response <=.001; no assumption that the inherited branch is zero.
predictions.pred_e_zero_fit_literal_weight_program: All tensors come from checkpoint weights and live residual inputs; there are no labels, fitting steps, gradients, or updates.

decision: Screen promotes a literal local L11/L15 reader-router-writer program and exposes whether recursive upstream compilation must include inherited initial values. Null preserves the causal source interface but blocks weight adoption and redirects to the failed local identity.
